## Why

Explain the problem or decision this change addresses.

## What changed

Describe the behavior and boundaries changed by this pull request.

## Impact

Describe effects on public APIs, packaging, documentation, or adjacent components.

## Validation

List the exact commands or scenarios used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one coherent purpose.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed contract or invariant.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or architecture changed.
- [ ] Formatting, linting, typing, and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] No secrets, generated caches, or unrelated changes are included.
